abi.entrypoint: single-request text generation compatible with the vLLM offline LLM API

computation.definition: Run the frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B text backbone autoregressively. Given one tokenized prompt, compute the exact model forward recurrence and append 128 greedy tokens. The execution includes embedding, 18 Gated DeltaNet blocks, 6 full-attention blocks, FFN, normalization, LM head and token selection; vision inputs are absent.
dependencies: each generated token depends on the complete recurrent/KV state from all earlier tokens
three Gated DeltaNet layers precede each full-attention layer in every four-layer group
all cross-operator fusions must preserve model weights, state updates, causal masking and greedy token sequence
forbidden_rewrites: weight quantization below the frozen BF16 checkpoint
changed model weights or skipped layers
legal_rewrites: equivalent weight and activation layout changes
CUDA graph capture and launch batching
mathematically equivalent scheduling and compiler substitutions

numerics.acceptance: Every workload case must generate exactly the same 128 token IDs as the frozen baseline. When token logprobs are available, maximum absolute logprob difference must also be <= 1e-3; missing logprobs do not weaken the exact-token requirement.
numerics.reference: Frozen upstream Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B checkpoint executed in BF16 with greedy decoding and text-only inputs.
